headline: Lawson headlines a live music set in Austin
body: Liam Lawson & Friends will headline VCARB Garage Sessions at Inn Cahoots in Austin on 22 October. The music programme runs from 7pm to 9:15pm as part of Esses Bazaar ATX ahead of the United States Grand Prix.

headline: COTA adds a giant cowboy hat for the US Grand Prix
body: Circuit of the Americas is adding a giant cowboy hat with a Western-themed bar inside at Lone Star Land. A Guinness World Records official is due to inspect it on the Thursday before the race; a record has yet to be verified.
